verdict.rationale: Wave is a small-business accounting SaaS that holds sensitive financial data, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it offers an AI-training opt-out. The evidence pack covers invoicing, payments, payroll, receipts OCR and reporting, but contains no policy, setting or statement about excluding customer data from AI model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
